lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary longitudinal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the branchial region, extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal carinae and longitudinal blob rows to form a rectangular coordinate-like lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity upper margins and low-intensity shadow regions immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of faint, high-luminance circular clusters bounded within the leading edge and mid-section of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial frequency of small-diameter high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger, lower-frequency blobs on the main lateral body.
